_comment: One entry of the reaction library, library/reactions/reactions.json: {"version": 1, "entries": {"<id>": <entry>}}. The library is an index of real ranges of real posts: the video stays where it is (research/ or apps/<slug>/niche/batches/) and is never copied. scripts/planning/reactions.py writes it (add, describe, fill); the Atlas Reactions page writes the user's fields. Times: start_s and end_s are seconds in the post; each expression beat's times are seconds from start_s. status: proposed (by an agent), kept (only the user sets it), retired. set_by_you lists the fields the user set; an agent never changes them. fit is computed by reactions.py fill from people, speech, cuts, face_hidden_s and the length. Tags come from docs/character/reaction-tags.json.
